name: libavif (avifenc)
notes: 2026-11-01: AVIF still and animated encoding with alpha from PNG sequences.
2026-11-01: Pin codec and speed for byte-stable output.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it a strong candidate.
2026-11-24: Toolkit guide written on partial evidence; states lossy alpha reached 254 not 255 and recommends lossless or verifying alpha for compositing.

evidence.result: Partial: 8 of 9 predeclared checks pass. Lossless avifenc -l to avifdec is pixel-identical (RGBA SHA-256 match), 64x64, alpha 0-255 with 16 levels. Lossy -q 60 --qalpha 60: 64x64, alpha 0-254 with 17 levels (fails predeclared max 255), PSNR 52.2968 dB against 35 dB floor. Repeat run identical. aom 3.15.3 encoder, dav1d 1.5.4 decoder, ImageMagick 7.1.2-35, Python 3.12.2.
evidence.scope: Lossless AVIF round-trip pixel-identical with alpha and dims; q60 lossy 52.3 dB PSNR but alpha max 254 not 255; macOS arm64, 64x64 only

summary: C implementation of AVIF encoding and decoding, including the avifenc and avifdec CLIs. It supports stills and sequences with alpha, with encoder behavior depending on the enabled AV1 codec backend.
use_when: Encode AVIF stills or image sequences with explicit codec controls
Use when AVIF-specific options matter beyond a generic image CLI
avoid_when: Use FFmpeg for broad audio/video muxing and sequence handling

assessment.rationale: Latest release v1.2.1 is dated 2025-03-17; official repository activity and release checklist updates continued in 2026, supporting active maintenance. Includes avifenc/avifdec; backend codecs remain configurable.
